entries.label: Version 20
entries.prompt:
NEW TASK — start from scratch now. Ignore anything you believe you completed earlier; no part of this task has been done yet.

Working file: index.html in this project (371 KB, single file, "Vegetable Contractor — Management App"). Open it and read it before changing anything.

Task: visual and interaction polish only. The JavaScript engine must keep working exactly as it does now — do not rewrite it, do not remove screens, do not change data shapes or the window.app API.

Requirements:
- Keep exactly 42 <section class="screen"> blocks with their current ids.
- Refine typography hierarchy, spacing rhythm, glass surface/elevation depth, button and list-row sizing, modal header/footer composition, empty states, and subtle screen transitions.
- Respect prefers-reduced-motion.
- No lorem ipsum, no placeholder images, keep all seed data.

Definition of done — verify before you finish, and report the output:
1. `grep -c 'class="screen' index.html` returns 42.
2. `grep -c 'prefers-reduced-motion' index.html` returns at least 1.
3. Load index.html headless and confirm no console errors.
The file's mtime must change; if it does not, you have not done the task.
